responsibility: Declares the SARIF sink API, serialization abstractions, SARIF version/generation options, and SARIF-specific JSON object wrappers used by the diagnostics subsystem. It exposes helpers for opening SARIF output files and constructing SARIF sinks, plus the sarif_property_bag, sarif_object, sarif_graph/node/edge, and graph-conversion entry points that let other diagnostics components attach structured graph and logical-location data to SARIF output.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration and type-definition side of the SARIF sink pair: it exposes sink-construction/file-opening APIs, SARIF option structs, serialization interfaces, and wrapper classes for SARIF objects and graphs, while sarif-sink.cc implements their concrete generation and serialization behavior.
